blockers.finding: After process death during Planner and before terminal sidecar/receipt, an old command is indistinguishable from a new command on cache miss
blockers.required: Define server-minted current-incarnation command admission or a durable pre-Planner attempt marker; old unknown IDs must never regenerate Registry calls
blockers.test: Terminate inside first Registry invocation before terminal records; restart and retry same ID with zero new Registry calls; separately admit a genuinely new server-minted command

implementation_constraints: SQLite writer is database-wide, not lesson-local
Do not hold a global cache mutex across SQL/handler/recovery
Sidecar Flush+Sync after transaction/connection release; do not claim context can cancel fsync
Reserve bounded cache capacity before Planner and never evict unknown entries
Global integrity must retain orphan and unsupported-fact checks and per-lesson immutable creation checks
text_corrections: Section1 outside-transaction planning contradicts detailed writer-inside planning
Meanings are frozen context/outbox data, not index-only parameters or summary audit
